question: Find the distance between the lines: $\vec{r}=(\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-4\hat{k})+\lambda(2\hat{i}+3\hat{j}+6\hat{k})$; $\vec{r}=(3\hat{i}+3\hat{j}-5\hat{k})+\mu(4\hat{i}+6\hat{j}+12\hat{k})$
explanation:
**Step 1:** Notice that the direction vectors are parallel: $\vec{b}_1 = 2\hat{i}+3\hat{j}+6\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}_2 = 4\hat{i}+6\hat{j}+12\hat{k} = 2\vec{b}_1$. This means the lines are parallel. We use the shared direction vector $\vec{b} = 2\hat{i}+3\hat{j}+6\hat{k}$. Here $\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i}+2\hat{j}-4\hat{k}$ and $\vec{a}_2 = 3\hat{i}+3\hat{j}-5\hat{k}$.
**Step 2:** Calculate $\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}$. Now compute the cross product $\vec{b} \times (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) = \left|\begin{matrix}\hat{i}&\hat{j}&\hat{k}\\ 2&3&6\\ 2&1&-1\end{matrix}\right| = \hat{i}(-3-6) - \hat{j}(-2-12) + \hat{k}(2-6) = -9\hat{i} + 14\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}$.
**Step 3:** Distance $d = \frac{|\vec{b} \times (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)|}{|\vec{b}|} = \frac{\sqrt{(-9)^2 + 14^2 + (-4)^2}}{\sqrt{2^2+3^2+6^2}} = \frac{\sqrt{81+196+16}}{\sqrt{49}} = \frac{\sqrt{293}}{7}\text{ units}$.
